title: Deductible Rewards Entitlements by Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage Option
content:
Deductible Rewards is the vanishing-deductible feature of Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage. Whether it may be enrolled, and the credit figures it carries, are set by the vehicle's deductible option.

| Deductible option | Deductible Rewards may be enrolled | Enrollment credit (USD) | Annual credit (USD) | Maximum credit (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Physical Damage $2,000 Deductible | No | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $1,000 Deductible | Yes | 100 | 100 | 500 |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $750 Deductible | Yes | 100 | 100 | 500 |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $500 Deductible | Yes | 100 | 100 | 500 |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $250 Deductible | Yes | 100 | 100 | 250 |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $100 Deductible | No | 0 | 0 | 0 |

## Column meanings

- **Deductible Rewards may be enrolled**: whether the feature may be enrolled on this option.
- **Enrollment credit**: the credit granted when Deductible Rewards is enrolled.
- **Annual credit**: the option's annual Deductible Rewards credit figure for a claim-free year.
- **Maximum credit**: the option's Deductible Rewards maximum credit figure.

## Points of reading

- The four options from $1,000 down to $250 carry the feature; the $2,000 and $100 options do not, and every credit figure on those two options is 0.
- The $250 option carries the same enrollment and annual credit as the $1,000, $750 and $500 options but a lower maximum (250 against 500).
- *Hypothetical:* a vehicle moving from the $500 option to the $250 option keeps an annual credit figure of 100 while the option's maximum falls from 500 to 250.
